title: Efficient Acquisition of Short Tandem Repeats in Single-Cell Whole-Genome-Amplified DNA
author: Tao, Marx, et al.

steps.title: Prepare SYBR and KOD custom mix
steps.instruction: Make SYBR 100× by mixing 10 µL SYBR Green I stock (Lonza, 10 000×) with 990 µL DMSO (Sigma). Then prepare 2 mL KOD 5× Custom Mix by adding the following to reach the final concentrations: 0.27 µL ddH₂O, 2.5 µL 10× KOD Buffer (Merck) → 1× in reaction, 1.5 µL 25 mM MgSO₄ (Merck) → 1.5 mM, 7.5 µL 25 mM dNTP mix (Bioline) → 7.5 mM each dNTP, 0.2 µL KOD Enzyme (1 U/µL, Merck) → 0.2 U/µL, 0.025 µL SYBR 100× (Lonza) → 0.025×, and water to a total volume of 52 µL per reaction.

steps.title: Set up Pre‑Amp PCR (8 reactions)
steps.instruction: Dilute the synthesized oligo pool (Custom Array) to 1 ng/µL. For each 45 µL reaction combine: 0.2 µL (0.2 ng/µL) template, 0.3 µL (10 pmol/µL) OM4_Mly_F primer, 0.3 µL (10 pmol/µL) OM4_Mly_R primer, 9 µL KOD 5× Custom Mix, and 31.5 µL ddH₂O. Run PCR on a LightCycler 480 with: 95 °C 120 s; 95 °C 20 s ×18; 60 °C 10 s; 70 °C 5 s; 70 °C 50 s; hold 4 °C. Purify each product with a MinElute PCR Purification Kit (Qiagen) and quantify DNA using the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit (Life Technologies).

steps.title: Perform Production PCR (48 reactions)
steps.instruction: Dilute the purified Pre‑Amp product to 1 ng/µL. For each 45 µL reaction combine: 0.2 µL (0.2 ng/µL) template, 0.3 µL (10 pmol/µL) OM4_Mly_F primer, 0.3 µL (10 pmol/µL) OM4_Mly_R primer, 9 µL KOD 5× Custom Mix, and 31.5 µL ddH₂O. Run PCR with: 95 °C 120 s; 95 °C 20 s ×12; 60 °C 10 s; 70 °C 5 s; 70 °C 50 s; hold 4 °C. Pool all 48 PCR products and purify using MinElute columns (Qiagen), eluting 45 µL ddH₂O per column. Combine all eluates, measure concentration on a NanoDrop spectrophotometer, dilute the pool to approximately 30 ng/µL, and retain 20 µL for later quality‑control.

steps.title: Digest duplex MIPs with MlyI
steps.instruction: Mix 25 µL diluted DNA (30 ng/µL) with 10 µL 10× NEB Smarter Buffer and 6 µL MlyI (10 U/µL) to give a final MlyI concentration of 0.6 U/µL in a total volume of 100 µL. Incubate at 37 °C overnight, then heat‑inactivate at 80 °C for 20 min. Store the digest at 4 °C.

steps.title: Purify and quantify digested MIPs
steps.instruction: Purify the MlyI‑digested DNA with a MinElute column, pool the eluates into one tube, and determine the concentration using the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit (Life Technologies).

steps.title: Quality‑control digested product size
steps.instruction: Run both the digested sample (from step 4) and an undigested control on an Agilent TapeStation. The digested duplex MIPs should appear at ~105 bp and the undigested DNA at ~150 bp.

steps.title: Dilute final duplex MIP pool
steps.instruction: Dilute the pooled duplex MIPs to a stock concentration of 80 nM (80 fmol/µL, ≈5.8 ng/µL). Further dilute this stock to 8 nM to create a working solution. Store both stock and working solutions at –20 °C.

steps.title: Thaw single‑cell WGA DNA
steps.instruction: Clean the bench with 70 % ethanol. Retrieve the plate of whole‑genome‑amplified DNA from the –20 °C freezer, thaw at room temperature, shake on a bench‑top mixer, and spin briefly (≈30 s at 500 rpm). Keep the plate sealed to avoid cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Barcoding PCR for each sample
steps.instruction: For each sample, combine in a 20 µL reaction: 2 µL diluted duplex MIP template (from step 3), 0.5 µL i5‑index primer (5 pmol/µL), 0.5 µL i7‑index primer (5 pmol/µL), 10 µL NEBNext Ultra II Q5 2× Master Mix, 0.5 µL SYBR 100×, and 5 µL ddH₂O. Run the following program: 98 °C 30 s; 98 °C 10 s; 5 cycles of 56 °C 30 s → 65 °C 45 s; 15 cycles of 65 °C 75 s; 65 °C 5 min; hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Clean up barcoded PCR products
steps.instruction: In a 96‑well plate add 0.8× volume of AMPure XP SPRI beads to each PCR reaction, incubate according to the manufacturer’s protocol using the Tecan liquid‑handling system, and elute DNA in 40 µL ddH₂O. Manually pool equal volumes (typically 2 µL) of each purified sample. Concentrate the pooled library with a MinElute kit, eluting in 35 µL ddH₂O.

steps.title: Size‑select diagnostic library
steps.instruction: Retain 3 µL of the concentrated pool for QC. Load 30 µL of the pool onto a BluePippin (Sage Science) 2 % V1 cassette, selecting fragments 240–340 bp. (Agarose gel extraction of the same size range is an alternative.) Purify the size‑selected eluate with a MinElute column, eluting in 15 µL ddH₂O. Measure concentration with the Qubit dsDNA HS assay and inspect size distribution on a TapeStation (single peak around 300 bp). Dilute the library to 12 µL of 4 nM (4 fmol/µL) for sequencing.

steps.title: Diagnostic sequencing
steps.instruction: Load the 4 nM library at 10 pM onto a MiSeq Nano flow cell (300‑cycle kit) in paired‑end mode with Read1/Read2 = 151 bp and Index1/Index2 = 8 bp. After sequencing, demultiplex with bcl2fastq, merge overlapping reads using `pear -v 40 -m 300 -f fastq1 -r fastq2 -o pear_files_prefix`, and map merged reads to the custom STR reference with `bowtie2 -x index_files_prefix -U merged_fastq | samtools view -bS - | samtools sort -o sorted_assignment_bam`. Extract per‑sample read counts from the sorted BAM file using pysam.

steps.title: Balance reads for production sequencing
steps.instruction: Calculate a scaling volume for each sample based on its diagnostic read count to equalize coverage (e.g., pool 2 µL of a sample with 500 reads and 1 µL of a sample with 1 000 reads). Pool the scaled volumes manually or with an Echo550, concentrate the combined pool with MinElute, elute in 35 µL ddH₂O, and prepare the production sequencing library as described in step 11.

steps.title: Production sequencing
steps.instruction: Sequence the final library on a NextSeq 500 high‑output flow cell using 151 bp paired‑end reads, 8 bp dual indexes, and a loading concentration of 1.8–2.2 pM. Aim for ≥1 M reads per sample; up to 200 samples can be run on one flow cell. If any sample falls short of the desired read count, a repeat run on the same library (or on a higher‑throughput platform such as NovaSeq) may be performed.

description: The protocol below describes the specific steps for using whole genome amplified genomic DNA (REPLI-g Mini Kit, Qiagen) from Du145 single cells for the 12K OM6 STR panel presented in our Cell Reports Methods paper (Tao et al., 2021) (Custom Array). However, we have also used this protocol for primary cells such as melanoma, leukemia, T-cells, Macrophages, etc. and other whole genome amplification kits such as REPLI-g Single Cell Kit, Ampli1WGA kit, MALBAC single cell WGA kit etc.
